input.portPlanDimension: missing, renamed, malformed, and unknown fields (msc2-port-plan.md line 187, first sub-item)
input.description: A single per-server entry inside servers[] carrying only the handful of keys an early MSC 1 release wrote for a server: id, displayName, serverDir, paperJarPath, and RAM -- none of xboxBroadcastEnabled, autoBackup*, notificationPrefs, playit*, etc.

expected.claim: Every ConfigServer field absent from a server's JSON decodes to its own static default (not one derived from AppConfig's top-level defaults, unlike the app-config-level dimension above) rather than failing decode.

notes: Kept as its own matrix entry rather than folded into missing-fields-default-app-config: ConfigServer.init(from:) (source lines 336-398) is a separate decoder from AppConfig.init(from:), with its own defaulting, and P5.4 already ported it as a separate fixture/test -- splitting here preserves that same one-decoder-one-case granularity instead of inventing a merged dimension the port's own tests don't share.
